hero.badge: Gahunda yo Kongera Ubudahangarwa ku Mihindagurikire y'Ikirere muri Afurika
hero.headline: Kwagura Ibisubizo bishingiye ku Rusobe rw'Ibinyabuzima mu Kibaya cya Nyabarongo yo Hasi
hero.subheadline: Kugaragaza uburyo gutera amashyamba, ubuhinzi buvanze n'amashyamba, no gusana inkombe z'imigezi birinda Kigali imyuzure ikomeye, guhagarika inkangu, no guhanga imirimo itangiza ibidukikije.

climate.name: Guhangana n'Ikirere
climate.short_desc: Kugabanya inkangu, kurwanya isuri, no gukumira imyuzure mu misozi ihanamiye no mu mikoki ya Kigali.
climate.headline: Kubaka Ubudahangarwa guhera ku Misozi kugera mu Bibaya by'Imigezi
climate.what_is_it: Guhangana n'imihindagurikire y'ikirere binyuze mu bisubizo kamere (NbS) bikoresha tekiniki zishingiye ku rusobe rw'ibinyabuzima—nko guca amaterasi y'indagano, gutera imigano ku nkombe, no gutera amashyamba ku misozi ihanamiye—kugira ngo amazi y'imvura anywe mu butaka Kigali irindwe imyuzure y'inkukuma.
climate.why_it_matters: Umujyi wa Kigali uhura n'imvura nyinshi zikabije. Imyuzure mu mukoki wa Mpazi no mu gishanga cya Nyabugogo ikunze kwangiza imihanda, inzu, n'amasoko y'ubucuruzi. Gusana ibibaya by'amazi birinda abaturage basaga 250,000.
climate.what_suncasa_does: Umushinga SUNCASA usana imisozi ya Yanze, Mpazi, na Mont Kigali. Binyuze mu guca amaterasi y'indagano no gutera ibiti by'inganzamarumbo, amazi y'isuri afatwa hakiri kare mbere yo gusenyera abatuye hasi.

biodiversity.name: Kurengera Urusobe rw'Ibinyabuzima
biodiversity.short_desc: Gutera ibiti gakondo by'u Rwanda, gusana metero 30 z'umukandara w'uruzi rwa Nyabarongo, no kugarura ibinyabuzima.
biodiversity.headline: Kugarura Ibiti Gakondo no Kurengera Inkombe z'Imigezi
biodiversity.what_is_it: Kurengera urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima byibanda ku gutera amoko y'ibiti kavukire by'u Rwanda (nka Polyscias fulva / Umwungo, Markhamia lutea / Umusave, na Ficus thonningii / Umuvumu) no kubungabunga umukandara wa metero 30 ku nkombe za Nyabarongo n'ibishanga byayo.
biodiversity.why_it_matters: Gukoresha ubutaka nabi no gutera ubwoko bumwe bw'ibiti byangije inzira z'inyamaswa n'ubushobozi bw'ubutaka bwo gufata amazi. Kurengera inkombe z'amazi birinda isoko y'uruganda rwa Yanze rutanga amazi meza angana na 60% akoreshwa i Kigali.
biodiversity.what_suncasa_does: SUNCASA ifatanya n'Ikigo cy'Amashyamba (RFA) gutera ingemwe zirenga miliyoni 1.2, gusana ibirometero 45 by'inkombe z'imigezi, no gukurikirana imikurire y'ibiti binyuze mu ikoranabuhanga rya GPS.

gesi.name: Uburinganire n'Ubwuzuzanye (GESI)
gesi.short_desc: Gushyigikira abagore mu nzego z'ubuyobozi bw'amazi, guha urubyiruko amahugurwa ya GIS, no kunganira ingo zikene.
gesi.headline: Gushyira Abagore n'Urubyiruko ku Isonga mu Miyoborere y'Ikirere
gesi.what_is_it: Gahunda y'uburinganire n'ubwuzuzanye (GESI) yinjiza abagore, urubyiruko, n'ingo zitishoboye mu gufata ibyemezo, kuyobora, no kungukira mu bikorwa byose byo gusana ibibaya.
gesi.why_it_matters: Abagore n'urubyiruko nibo bibasirwa cyane n'ibiza by'imyuzure n'inkangu, nyamara bakenshi ntibagira ijambo mu makoperative cyangwa komite z'amazi. Kurengera ibidukikije birambye bisaba ko bose babyibonamo.
gesi.what_suncasa_does: SUNCASA itegeka ko abagore bagize nibura 50% bya komite z'ibibaya, igaha igishoro koperative z'ubuhumbikiro ziyobowe n'abagore, ikanahugura urubyiruko mu gupima amashyamba hifashishijwe indege zitarimo abapilote (drones) na GIS.

economy.name: Imirimo n'Ubukungu
economy.short_desc: Guhanga imirimo y'icyatsi, guteza imbere abahinzi b'ibiti by'imbuto n'ibya makadamiya, no kwinjiza amafaranga mu buhumbikiro.
economy.headline: Guhanga Imirimo y'Icyatsi no Kongera Ubutunzi bw'Abaturage
economy.what_is_it: Inkingi y'ubukungu ihuza kurengera ibidukikije no guha abaturage amikoro arambye—harimo akazi ko guca amaterasi gahabwa ingemwe, ubuhinzi bw'ibiti by'imbuto z'agaciro (avoka, makadamiya), no kugurisha ingemwe.
economy.why_it_matters: Abatuye mu nkengero za Kigali bakeneye amahirwe y'ubukungu atangiza ibidukikije, kugira ngo ibikorwa byo gusana amashyamba n'ibibaya birambe kandi bitange umusaruro ufatika.
economy.what_suncasa_does: SUNCASA imaze guhanga iminsi y'akazi k'icyatsi isaga 42,000, yahaye abahinzi basaga 2,850 ibiti by'imbuto, ndetse amakoperative yinjije asaga miliyoni 48 z'amafaranga y'u Rwanda mu kugurisha ingemwe.

fmes_interoperability.title: Ikoranabuhanga rihuza na Sisitemu ya RFA FMES
fmes_interoperability.subtitle: Byubatswe mu buryo bworohereza Ikigo cy'Amashyamba guhanahana amakuru nta mbogamizi.
fmes_interoperability.card1_desc: Buri gace k'imirimo gahujwe na kode zemewe z'amashyamba za RFA (urugero: COMP-GAS-JB-01) n'amoko y'ibiti.
fmes_interoperability.card2_desc: Amakuru yose n'amakarita bishobora gukurwamo ako kanya mu buryo bwa mudasobwa hifashishijwe amadosiye ya JSON.
fmes_interoperability.card3_desc: Byubatswe mu buryo bwa 'client-side' budasaba seriveri zikomeye, bigatuma abakozi ba RFA babicunga bitabagoye.

footer.about: Umushinga SUNCASA uterwa inkunga na Global Affairs Canada, ukaba uyobowe n'ibigo IISD na WRI ku bufatanye n'Umujyi wa Kigali n'Ikigo cy'Igihugu Gishinzwe Amashyamba (RFA).
footer.rights: Amakuru yose y'ubugenzuzi ashyizwe ahagaragara ku buntu ku bw'Inzego za Leta y'u Rwanda n'abafatanyabikorwa mu kurengera ikirere.
